personas.label: First-time shop owner
personas.summary: A bakery owner who wants to take local orders online.
goals: Accept pre-orders before the morning rush
personas.context: Uses the app from a bakery counter between customer orders.
personas.knowledge: Comfortable with messaging apps but new to online ordering tools.
frustrations: Manual order notes are easy to lose

jobs.statement: When the shop is busy, accept a customer pre-order quickly.
jobs.success_outcome: The order is confirmed with a pickup time.

tone.notes: Keep order states easy to scan.

accessibility.notes: Keyboard and touch use are in scope.

design_system.notes: Use the existing bakery brand tokens.

decisions.decision: Show open orders before the product catalog.
decisions.reason: The owner checks active pickups first.

open_questions: Should customers be able to change a pickup time?
